source: Wave 6 Step 1 on-chain verification (2026-06-01). USDC (native) at 0x0b2C... is Circle's native deployment post-2023; preferred for new pools and where Slipstream lives. USDCE at 0x7F5c... is the legacy bridged USDC, still hosts deep UniV3 pools from the pre-native era. WETH is the OP-Stack canonical predeploy at 0x4200...0006 (same address as Base/Unichain).

WETH.note: Canonical OP-Stack WETH predeploy. Identical address on Base, Unichain, Mode, Zora, etc.

USDC.note: Native Circle USDC on Optimism (launched 2023). Preferred quote leg for arb investigations. Velodrome Slipstream pools live here.

USDCE.note: Bridged USDC.e (pre-native USDC era; legacy). May still hold deep UniV3 pools from before the 2023 Circle launch. Detect and prefer native USDC where both exist for the same pair.
